svg.text: L = w², w = x·y + sin x, at x = 2, y = 3
forward pass — carries values, left to right, one sweep
x is used twice, so its adjoint is a sum over outgoing edges
Forward mode would need two sweeps here: one seeded at x, one at y
reverse pass — carries adjoints ∂L/∂(node), right to left, one sweep per output
